'''Septo''' was a [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]]. The [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] was sketched by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in one of his many personal journals, which he kept during his [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] under [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Septo was represented alongside several [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] figures, such as the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Sidewa]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Waiter/Legends|waitress]] [[Hermione Bagwa/Legends|Hermione Bagwa]].<ref name="AJJ" />
